blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Dengue and leptospirosis cases nationwide declined in the latest reporting period, according to the Department of Health (DOH). Dengue cases In the latest two-week reporting period, dengue cases stood at 22,095 from Sept. 17 to Sept. 30, two percent lower than the 22,479 cases recorded from Sept. 3 to Sept. 16. The decline was also reflected in the year-to-date figures. The DOH recorded a total of 205,347 dengue cases as of Oct. 14, down 22 percent from the 261,749 cases reported during the same period in 2025.
